note: A 是 B 的 两 倍 = A is twice B. 增加 了 两 倍 vs 增加 到 两 倍 differ; check which.

examples.zh: 这个房间是那个的两倍大。
examples.en: This room is twice as big as that one.

examples.zh: 今年的价格是去年的三倍。
examples.en: This year's price is three times last year's.

examples.zh: 他的工资比我高一倍。
examples.en: His salary is double mine.

note: 擦 桌子 / 擦 汗 / 擦 药 (apply ointment).

examples.zh: 请把桌子擦干净。
examples.en: Please wipe the table clean.

examples.zh: 下雨了，请把车擦干净。
examples.en: It rained; please wipe the car clean.

examples.zh: 医生让我一天擦两次药。
examples.en: The doctor told me to apply the ointment twice a day.

meaning: to roll up; to sweep up

senses.en: to roll up; to sweep up

note: Read juǎn. 卷 起 袖子 = roll up sleeves. Slang 内卷/卷 = rat race.

examples.zh: 请把这张纸卷起来。
examples.en: Please roll this sheet of paper up.

examples.zh: 请把地图卷好，放在包里。
examples.en: Please roll up the map and put it in the bag.

examples.zh: 风把地上的叶子卷起来了。
examples.en: The wind swept the leaves up off the ground.

examples.zh: 这位护士对病人很好。
examples.en: This nurse is very kind to patients.

examples.zh: 我姐姐在医院当护士。
examples.en: My older sister works as a nurse in the hospital.

examples.zh: 请叫护士来一下，好吗？
examples.en: Could you call the nurse over, please?

note: 一共 is the everyday word; 共 is shorter, used before numbers: 共 三 百 元.

examples.zh: 这些菜共一百二十元。
examples.en: These dishes come to 120 yuan in total.

examples.zh: 我们共五个人，有地方吗？
examples.en: There are five of us in all; do you have room?

examples.zh: 我们共去了三次。
examples.en: We went three times in total.

note: 办 手续 的 程序 (the steps of a process); 程序员 = programmer.

examples.zh: 办手续的程序太复杂了。
examples.en: The procedure for the paperwork is too complicated.

examples.zh: 我哥哥在公司写程序。
examples.en: My brother writes programs at a company.

examples.zh: 这个程序一直出错，怎么办？
examples.en: This program keeps crashing; what should I do?

note: 鱼刺 = fish bone; 扎 / 刺 = to prick.

examples.zh: 吃鱼的时候要小心鱼刺。
examples.en: Watch out for fish bones when you eat fish.

examples.zh: 这种花有刺，别用手拿。
examples.en: This kind of flower has thorns; don't pick it up by hand.

examples.zh: 这条鱼刺很多，不好吃。
examples.en: This fish has lots of bones and isn't easy to eat.

examples.zh: 这个孩子很勇敢，打针不哭。
examples.en: This child is brave and doesn't cry at injections.

examples.zh: 你要勇敢一点儿，不要怕。
examples.en: Be a bit braver; don't be afraid.

examples.zh: 他勇敢地说出了自己的想法。
examples.en: He bravely said what he thought.

note: For people or work: 优秀 学生/员工/作品. Stronger than 好.

examples.zh: 她是我们班最优秀的学生。
examples.en: She is the best student in our class.

examples.zh: 公司需要更多优秀的人才。
examples.en: The company needs more outstanding talent.

examples.zh: 你的成绩很优秀，继续努力。
examples.en: Your grades are excellent; keep it up.

note: 极 了 after an adjective: 好 极 了 (great); also 极 + adj: 极 大.

examples.zh: 今天的天气好极了！
examples.en: The weather today is wonderful!

examples.zh: 这个办法极有用。
examples.en: This method is extremely useful.

examples.zh: 我累极了，想马上回家。
examples.en: I'm exhausted and want to go home right away.

note: 山顶 = mountain top; 一 顶 帽子 = a hat. Not "to push" here.

examples.zh: 我们爬到了山顶，风景真美。
examples.en: We climbed to the top of the mountain, and the view was beautiful.

examples.zh: 他买了一顶新帽子。
examples.en: He bought a new hat.

examples.zh: 我住在楼顶，夏天很热。
examples.en: I live on the top floor, and it's hot in summer.

note: 注意 细节 = pay attention to details; 细节 决定 成败 is a saying.

examples.zh: 这份合同的细节你看了吗？
examples.en: Have you looked at the details of this contract?

examples.zh: 我们明天再谈细节吧。
examples.en: Let's talk about the details tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他很注意工作中的细节。
examples.en: He pays close attention to details in his work.

note: Rude if aimed at a person; used jokingly with friends: 我 真 笨.

examples.zh: 我真笨，又忘带手机了。
examples.en: I'm so dumb; I forgot my phone again.

examples.zh: 他手很笨，不会做饭。
examples.en: He is clumsy with his hands and can't cook.

examples.zh: 别说自己笨，你只是没学过。
examples.en: Don't call yourself stupid; you just haven't learned it.

note: 运气 好/不好; 祝 你 好 运气 is rarer than 祝 你 好运.

examples.zh: 今天我的运气真好，买到了票。
examples.en: I was really lucky today and got a ticket.

examples.zh: 他运气不好，又迟到了。
examples.en: He has bad luck; he's late again.

examples.zh: 这次考试我只能碰运气。
examples.en: I can only rely on luck for this exam.

meaning: pretty woman (casual; also a friendly address)

senses.en: pretty woman (casual; also a friendly address)

note: Casual; shop staff may call a woman customer 美女 as a friendly address. Use with care in formal settings.

examples.zh: 这位美女，想买什么？
examples.en: Miss, what would you like to buy?

examples.zh: 他女朋友是个大美女。
examples.en: His girlfriend is a real beauty.

examples.zh: 照片上的美女是谁？
examples.en: Who is the beautiful woman in the photo?

note: A 距离 B + 远/近 or 距离 + 时间/数: 距离 机场 十 公里.

examples.zh: 我家距离公司很近。
examples.en: My home is very close to the company.

examples.zh: 两个城市之间的距离有三百公里。
examples.en: The distance between the two cities is 300 kilometers.

examples.zh: 这里距离机场还有多远？
examples.en: How far is it from here to the airport?

note: 相处 得 好/不好; 和 + 人 + 相处.

examples.zh: 你跟同事相处得怎么样？
examples.en: How do you get along with your colleagues?

examples.zh: 他很容易跟别人相处。
examples.en: He is easy to get along with.

examples.zh: 我们相处了三年，感情很好。
examples.en: We've spent three years together and are very close.

note: 度过 + 时间: 度过 假期, 度过 难关 (get through hard times).

examples.zh: 我们在海边度过了一个好假期。
examples.en: We spent a good vacation by the sea.

examples.zh: 他是在医院度过的生日。
examples.en: He spent his birthday in the hospital.

examples.zh: 我们一起度过了最难的时候。
examples.en: Together we got through the hardest time.

meaning: to return; to belong to, be the responsibility of

senses.en: to return; to belong to, be the responsibility of

note: 归 + 人: 这 事 归 他 管 = he's in charge. 回归/归还 are the usual compounds.

examples.zh: 这件事归我管，你不用担心。
examples.en: This is my responsibility; you don't need to worry.

examples.zh: 借的书要归还图书馆。
examples.en: Borrowed books must be returned to the library.

examples.zh: 这个房间归谁用？
examples.en: Who gets to use this room?

examples.zh: 天气热，请把窗户打开。
examples.en: It's hot; please open the window.

examples.zh: 这个窗户关不上了。
examples.en: This window won't close.

examples.zh: 他站在窗户旁边看外面。
examples.en: He stood by the window looking outside.
